slot.brief: Compute an expression of the form (z + z̄)/|z|² or similar, then raise to a power using De Moivre; ask for the real part or modulus.

stem: If $z=1+\sqrt{3}i$, find the real part of $\left(\dfrac{z^2}{|z|^2}\right)^5$.

verdicts.working: |z|=2 and arg(z)=π/3, so z²/|z|²=e^{2πi/3}. Its fifth power has real part cos(10π/3)=−1/2.

working:
$|z|=2$, $\arg z=\dfrac{\pi}{3}$; hence $\dfrac{z^2}{|z|^2}=e^{2\pi i/3}$. $\Re\left(e^{10\pi i/3}\right)=\cos\dfrac{4\pi}{3}=-\dfrac{1}{2}$.

Independent check: |z|=2 and arg(z)=π/3, so z²/|z|²=e^{2πi/3}. Its fifth power has real part cos(10π/3)=−1/2.
